verdict.rationale: Mangopay offers webhooks that notify external systems on API object events, and documented 'custom logic to detect and mitigate fraud attempts,' both of which are event-driven mechanisms a developer could use to trigger automated actions. However, this requires building the rule/action logic externally rather than Mangopay providing a native rules engine or in-platform automation builder. Missing for 10: a first-party rules/automation engine, conditional action configuration UI, and evidence of end-to-end automated action execution (not just outbound notification).
